mapper.insert: INSERT INTO filter_presets (user_id, preset_name, start_year_month, end_year_month, categories) VALUES (#{userId}, #{request.presetName}, #{request.startYearMonth}, #{request.endYearMonth}, #{request.categories})
mapper.select: SELECT preset_id AS presetId, preset_name AS presetName, start_year_month AS startYearMonth, end_year_month AS endYearMonth, categories FROM filter_presets WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY preset_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE filter_presets SET user_id = #{userId} WHERE user_id IS NULL
